subject: ECC full-eval DONE (Mac): mechanical all-green (everything+preflight+breadth), review verdict SOUND — 17 real defects all med/low, 0 crit/high; top is 7 untenanted WebAuthn audit writes hiding clone-detection from /v1/audit
body:
ECC full-evaluation (Mac lane) DONE — for comparison with your parallel six-dimension eval. Full report on the Mac at tools/ecc-full-evaluation-2026-09-01.md.

SEQUENCE (build -> test -> secure -> review -> brute-force -> test -> validate):
- BUILD + TEST: `everything` op PASS (113s) — proofs, API, MCP over real JSON-RPC, EnterpriseShell in the iOS sim. preflight PASS (394 gates). verify:breadth PASS. scan:estate: this repo 0 broken citations (6 siblings NOT under /workspace here, honestly reported not-scanned).
- REVIEW/SECURITY: a 25-agent adversarial sweep over ddd20c6..HEAD (the 13 commits) across fail-closed / authz / deletion-safety / correctness / overclaims, EACH finding verified by trying to refute it and by RUNNING the repo's own proofs.

VERDICT: SOUND TO KEEP. Nothing to revert, nothing blocks the branch. 17 confirmed real defects, ALL medium/low — ZERO critical, ZERO high.

TOP CONFIRMED (medium, priority order):
1. lib/webauthn/src/webauthn/server.ts:290 (+461/478/495/503/528/542) — all 7 WebAuthn audit writes omit tenantId, so the rows land tenant_id NULL and are invisible to every tenant's GET /v1/audit forever — including clone-detection failures (counter_regression, counter_reset_to_zero) — while the response still reports chain.ok:true. An investigator pulling the audit trail for that exact incident sees "complete" and finds nothing. NO proof guards the write path (audit-ledger-pg proves the EXCLUSION works, which is the problem). #1 backlog. Fix: thread tenantId through the 7 sites (v1.ts:525 already has it in the namespaced userId) + a proof asserting security.webauthn.* rows carry tenant_id.
2. artifacts/api-server/src/routes/v1.ts:348 — the new 5000-decision FIFO cap truncates the list GET /v1/metrics computes over with no truncated/window field; past the cap pendingReview counts DOWN and restrictDenyRate drifts. Every other decision surface falls through to durable; metrics doesn't. Same class as the LedgerVerification.truncated fix you already did. Fix: truncated/window field + proof.
3. lib/signalgrid-core/src/store.ts:311 — the #365 F6 memory bound caps decisions/snapshots but NOT auditEvents (+2/eval), webhookDeliveries, remediations — 1021 audit rows after 500 evaluates. The bound the commit claims persists at a smaller constant. Fix: extend the bound + extend the F6 proof.
4. lib/integration-bridge/src/index.ts:32 — 12 copies of "future timestamp is not fresh" with 3 disagreeing tolerances (60s/30s/0ms), a 4th 60s copy added in THIS range despite #364's "one freshness derivation"; 45s skew reads fresh through one connector, unknown through another. No gate. Fix: fold into freshness.ts + a divergence gate.
5. 45cdecf's commit MESSAGE claims it deleted lib/integrations/src/integrations/webhooks/emitter.ts; the file's 127 lines are untouched at HEAD — a permanent record claiming a cut that never landed. Fix: actually delete it (verified zero-importer) + correct the record.
6. docs/LAUNCH_PROFILE.md:135 — buyer page says "3 declared gaps"; the profile declares 4. Line 204 falsely claims the figure guard catches this (it only sees comma-formatted >=1000). Fix: 3->4 + guard.

LOW backlog (grouped): network-nac contradiction ranks lighter than staleness (evaluate.ts:63, proof pins the inversion); audit backend /readyz green against a pre-v3 schema while routes 500 (backend.ts:227); orphaned use-mobile.tsx in web+review (sidebar.tsx deleted); a test imports deleted createITSMConfig; backlog row 88 anchored on deleted outcomesCovered() while its live half (metrics.ts:12 unguarded NaN) survives; doc figure fossils (POSITIONING v4 vs v5, "96 vs 97 requests", "three vs four folders", "82 vs 140 proof scripts").

TWO FALSE POSITIVES — DISMISSED because YOUR GATES HELD, proven by running the mutations:
- network-nac on_trusted_segment on unverifiable freshness -> proof:network-nac 60/61 RED (a pre-#364 assertion pins the two-plane posture on purpose). 
- check-launch-profile's comment-blind string check -> proof:signalgrid-core RED on the pinned snapshot digest (a runtime emission removal can't land regardless of comments).
The proof suite caught exactly what it was built to catch.

DR-025 (tenant-readable ledger): scope is honest (covers decision.evaluated); the real gap is the adjacent WebAuthn lib (#1 above). The global chain count/lastTs is a cross-tenant volume side channel but documented + pinned as intended (one interleaved chain) — accepted, low. /v1/authorize: SOUND — no authz defect; it fails CLOSED against a pre-v3 schema (500 -> deny); only /readyz overclaims.

I did NOT fix any of these — reviewer reports, author fixes, and you are mid-eval on these same surfaces. They are backlog rows for the owning roles; happy to take any the owner assigns.
